brandColors.$source: src/styles/tokens.css (the live site's own tokens). Do not add colors here without the owner.

teal.role: main brand color, structure, outline numerals

blue.role: links, active state (UI only, rarely in posts)

mist.role: secondary text on navy, hairlines on navy

red.role: the single accent: one rule, one chip, one number. Never large fills behind body text

logoInk.where: public/kurkoos-logo*.svg, dark logo ink. Not a design color.

rules: Red appears at most in two small places per design (a rule, a chip, a key number).
No gradients between brand colors. The only gradient allowed is a navy scrim over a photo, for legibility.
No gold. The old #ffd47a numeral color is retired: it is not on the site.

rule.desc: a thin red or mist line, 4 to 8 px, that anchors a headline

chip.desc: editorial label in caps or short Hebrew, Heebo 700, on red, navy or none

index.desc: numbering 01 02 03 in teal or red, Heebo 800

dimension.desc: architectural dimension line with end ticks, mist or teal, over a number

panel.desc: solid navy or paper panel holding specs, square corners

specRow.desc: label and value on one line, hairline between rows

signature.desc: logo and site address, the closing block of a design

mask.desc: photo inside a tall rectangle, an arch or a split. One mask per design

towers.desc: the four tower bars of the logo mark, used large and faint as a watermark

designComponents.rule: Every element must do a job: anchor, separate, count, measure or sign. If it only decorates, remove it.

scrimBottom.label: הצללה תחתונה
scrimBottom.use: text sits at the bottom of a photo

duotoneNavy.label: דואוטון כחול לילה
duotoneNavy.use: construction photos that are busy or have poor color. Never for a finished property sold on its looks.

rules: Never change how a real property looks: no added pools, sky swaps, removed buildings or fake greenery.
Crop, not stretch. Keep the focal point inside the crop.
A text area on a photo must reach 4.5:1 contrast. If it does not, add a scrim or move the text, do not lower the text size.

layouts.$note: Creative directions, not templates. The studio engine (public/engine/studio/directions.js) adapts each one to the copy and the photo: text length, image focal point, image brightness and format.

master.name: קבוצת קורקוס

rasterOnDark.note: white wordmark, red and teal interlocking O, transparent. Preferred for exports.

rasterOnLight.note: dark wordmark on a white square. Only on white or paper.

master.svgWarning: The SVG wordmarks are live <text> in Georgia, not outlines. On a machine without Georgia the letters change shape. For exported images use the PNG files.
master.clearSpace: the height of the tallest tower on every side

raita.note: white R with a red excavator, for dark backgrounds

shchinta.note: round badge, works on light and dark

afik.note: thin white AH monogram, dark backgrounds only

rules: Never stretch, recolor, rotate, outline or put a shadow on a logo. Scale proportionally only.
One master logo per design. A division logo may sit next to it as an endorsement, smaller.
Never put the Afik Hanahal logo on a construction post, or the Ra'ita logo on a brokerage post.

story.note: Instagram puts the profile row on top and the reply bar at the bottom

radius.note: Posts use square corners. Rounded cards read as an app, not a firm.

typography.$source: src/styles/tokens.css, src/styles/fonts.css, public/fonts/README.md (owner decision 19.10.2026: headlines Heebo, body Almoni)
missing: Almoni has no Medium or Black in the files the owner holds. Requests for 500 render 400; 600 to 900 render 700.
Fb Metropolis and PowerStation Solid are declared in fonts.css but were never bought. Do not use.

scale1080.$note: pixel sizes on a 1080 wide canvas. Headline size is fitted between min and max by the engine.

rules: Hebrew is set RTL. Latin words and digits inside Hebrew keep their own order (bidi).
Never break a line between a number and its unit (380 מ"ר), or after a one letter word (ו, ב, ל, ה, מ, ש, כ).
No dashes as punctuation in Hebrew copy. Use a period or a comma.
Use gershayim ״ and geresh ׳ where they belong (מ״ר, ת״א), not straight quotes, when the text is set large.
At most two families and three weights in one design.
Headlines: at most 8 words. Sub line: at most 14 words. Body on an image: never.
